notes.title: 游戏重大更新预告
notes.content:
大家好，经过开发组1个多月的紧张开发测试，近期将密集推出新的游戏内容。

具体的更新内容后续将出公告，敬请期待！

Thank you for your support for the game all the time. In order to welcome the arrival of the double festival, the development team has specially prepared a rich gift bag, which can be collected by entering the game mailbox. I wish you a happy holiday.

Package contents: Candy * 10, wedding wine * 10, Xingshi pill X10, COD ball X10, brown bear pill X10, cheetah pill X10, seal ball X10

notes.title: 8.26 minor version update
notes.content: Fixed a problem with some new players running back from scarecrow in level 7.

notes.title: 8.1 minor version update
7.28 version update notice
notes.content:
7.28 version update notice
1. Fixed the problem that Princess Pingyang failed to join the team;
2. Due to too much useless feedback from players, some unimportant plot characters, such as Zhang CiGong, Yuan Gu, Tang Meng, Yan Zhu and Guanfu, have been adjusted to leave the team after the completion of important plots.
3. Fixed the problem that merit was also calculated in ordinary level.
